data.title: 红莲 · 檐下微风共饮小酌
data.description: 夏日傍晚的和风长廊缘侧，清风摇动檐下风铃。红莲盘腿倚着木柱，嘴角带着爽朗又宠溺的笑意，将手中的朱红酒盏递到你唇边，邀你同饮这一盏微醺。
data.location: traditional wooden veranda overlooking serene countryside garden
data.action: leaning against wooden veranda pillar, holding out red sake cup with playful smirk, summer breeze rustling hair, wind chimes
data.lighting: golden late afternoon warmth with gentle shadows on wooden deck
data.mood: relaxed romantic camaraderie, playful teasing, peaceful summer afternoon
data.promptProse: Scarlet leans against a veranda pillar holding out a red sake cup with a charming smirk, summer breeze blowing through her white ponytail.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet offering a sake cup on a breezy wooden veranda with a playful smile.
